replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
After reviewing the video, I can conclude that you had used anti knockback. After death, you continued attempt walking forward, and at the end it's quite obvious that you were hit and didn't nudge. Your appeal has been denied.


Regards,
ViceWatercolour.
